name: Rutabegorz
tagline: Vibrant healthy eats and giant salads in a whimsical 1880s historic house
description: A beloved quirky Orange institution since 1970, Rutabegorz occupies a delightful 1880s Victorian home adorned with stained glass, antique posters, and plant-filled nooks. Known for its enormous, creative salads, hot wraps, homemade dips, vegetarian chili, and refreshing fruit smoothies.
historicNote: Situated in an authentic 1885 Eastlake-style Victorian residence, complete with a classic front porch and preserved interior pocket doors.

specials.title: Meatless Monday Soup & Salad

specials.title: Saturday Garden Salad Feature
